# iOS icon generator: SF Symbols and Iconify to Xcode assets

Curated by Skill Harbor — @affaan-m's iOS icon generator: turn an Iconify icon (200+ collections, 275,000+ open-source icons — internet required) or an SF Symbol (5,000+ Apple-native symbols — macOS only, works offline) into a complete Xcode `.imageset` (1x/2x/3x PNGs + Contents.json) with shell and Swift scripts — search across collections first, preview before generating, match the project's existing style (check size, color, weight of existing icons), generate straight into Assets.xcassets to skip manual copying, then visually verify the @2x PNG before committing. Includes a popular-collections reference (mdi, Phosphor, Solar, Tabler, Lucide, Remix Icon, Carbon, HeroIcons), symbol suggestions per use case, custom color/size/output options, and anti-patterns (never ship without a visual check, never use the default color when the project has a palette, never guess sizes). Honest caveats: **the skill is written in Japanese**; the SF Symbols path is macOS-only; listed here with credit to its creator; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
